TypeSafe API

Base URL: https://api.typesafe.example/v1

Authentication: send your API key as Authorization: Bearer YOUR_KEY. Create keys in the dashboard.

Usage

GET /usage?product=jev&from=2026-10-01 returns spend in USD by day for one product (jev, guard, scan).

Jev

Jev is TypeSafe's fast judge model. Its spend is reported by GET /usage?product=jev.
